title: C: Dining Philosophers
description: Simulate the dining philosophers problem with 5 philosophers and 5 forks, avoiding deadlock.

steps.title: Philosopher Simulation
steps.description: Define a `Philosopher` struct with id, state (THINKING/HUNGRY/EATING), and left/right fork. Simulate 5 philosophers. In each round, a hungry philosopher picks up both forks (if available), eats, then puts them down. Print state changes and detect if deadlock occurs.
hints: Fork available = true in a bool array.
Pick up left fork, then right fork.
If a fork is unavailable, the philosopher waits.
Put down both forks after eating.
